# The Mane Experience By Bri

> Luxury hair studio in Monroe, Georgia: frontal and closure wig installations, quick weaves with leave-out, custom wigs and ponytails. Healthy hair first.

- Address: 511 Gatewood Drive, Monroe, GA
- Phone: (770) 605-2782
- Email: themaneexperienceco@gmail.com
- Hours: Tue-Thu 8am-2pm; Fri-Sun by special availability
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/___brixana
- Booking: appointments are by request through https://themaneexperience.hair/booking (deposit and policies apply)
